en.text:
Grants an extra <solar/>Solar Melee Ability charge.

All Melee charges are recharged simultaneously.
(e.g.: both are recharged on Gambler's Dodge)

<solar/>Throwing Knife Kills increase <solar/>Throwing Knife damage by 30%|60%|200% after 1|2|3 Kills for 5 seconds. Casting Gambler's Dodge refreshes the buff's duration.

Interaction with the <solar/>Knock 'Em Down Aspect while <solar/>Radiant:
• Knife Kills restore 1 charge
• <solar/>Knife Trick Precision Kills and Direct <solar/>Ignition Kills in which Knife Trick applied the initial <solar/>Scorch restore both charges
